slots.description: Recurring schedules per account — assign a video by hand or let the system pick one.

slotForm.description: Set when and on which account this publishes automatically.
slotForm.saveError: Couldn't save the schedule. Try again.

assignVideo.title: Assign video
assignVideo.description: Pick an occurrence of this schedule and which video to publish. "Automatic" lets the system pick the oldest ready video when the time comes.
assignVideo.noOccurrences: This schedule has no upcoming occurrences — check its days and times.
assignVideo.saveError: Couldn't assign the video. Try again.

queue.description: Publication status updates automatically when the queue changes.
queue.empty: Nothing in the publish queue yet.

publishNow.title: Publish now
publishNow.description: Choose which accounts to publish "{jobTitle}" to. It uploads in the background, skipping the schedule.
publishNow.progressHint: You can close this window: the upload keeps going and the Library updates by itself.
publishNow.doneHint: Here's how "{jobTitle}" went on each account.
publishNow.retryFailed: Retry {count, plural, one {the failed one} other {the # failed}}

errors.tokenExpired: This account's session expired. Reconnect it in Channels and try again.
errors.quota: {platform} hit its upload limit for now. Try again later.
errors.network: The connection to {platform} dropped. Try again in a moment.
errors.missingFile: This video doesn't have the format {platform} needs.
errors.rejectedFile: {platform} didn't accept the file. Try again; if it repeats, check the detail.
errors.generic: Couldn't publish to {platform}. You can retry.
errors.tiktokUnaudited: TikTok hasn't approved your app yet: until then it only allows posting to private accounts. Set the account to private in the TikTok app and retry (the video is posted as "Only me").

automation.heading: Automation by category
automation.description: Each category publishes on its own channels with the ready videos. Saving replaces that category's slots on the chosen channels.
automation.noSlots: No slots: this category doesn't publish on its own yet.
automation.noAccounts: No connected accounts to publish to.
automation.replaceNote: Replaces the category's current slots on those channels.

planner.heading: AI planner
planner.description: Tell the AI what you want to publish this week; it proposes topic, design and time per day. The plan is a draft: producing is a separate step.
planner.emptyChat: E.g.: "Plan the week: NodeTech every day and History every other day, current topics".
planner.thinking: Thinking… this can take a couple of minutes.
planner.savePlan: {count, plural, =0 {Save plan} one {Save plan (#)} other {Save plan (#)}}
planner.saved: {count, plural, one {Saved # plan item} other {Saved # plan items}}
planner.savedEmpty: There is no saved plan yet.
planner.produceStarted: Preparation started. Follow its progress in the agenda.

dashboard.title: Scheduling
dashboard.description: Your content, its schedule and every stage in one place.

metrics.activeHint: Running or waiting for a slot

dashboard.loadError: Some data could not be refreshed. Last available results are preserved. Use Refresh to try again.
dashboard.emptyDescription: Change the date or filters to see other requests. You can also create a content plan.
dashboard.idle: No tasks are running now. Scheduled requests will start at their set time.
dashboard.pollingHint: Progress refreshes every 3–5 s during execution. New requests are detected every 15 s.
dashboard.flowHeading: Each stage has its own time

flow.preparation: Script, voice, transcription and scenes. Ready for your review.
flow.render: Converts prepared content into a video file when requested.
flow.publication: Sends the video to its channels at the scheduled date and time.

dashboard.activeSchedules: {count, plural, one {# active schedule} other {# active schedules}}
dashboard.footerNote: The agenda shows preparation times, editorial references, render start times and publications. Open an activity to see its details.
dashboard.settingsIntro: Manage publishing frequency and channels. Recurring schedules are configured in UTC.
dashboard.plannerIntro: Create an editorial plan. Saving proposals does not by itself set an exact preparation or render time.
dashboard.detailDescription: Times shown in {zone}. Each stage is managed separately.
dashboard.editorialTime: Editorial reference; it does not by itself schedule generation.
dashboard.requestTime: Request received time; not a scheduled execution time.
dashboard.noRenderScheduled: No render start time has been recorded yet.
dashboard.reviewFirst: You can review prepared content before recording or publishing.
dashboard.preparationStarted: Preparation started. Its progress will appear in the agenda.
dashboard.removeConfirm: Remove this activity from the plan?
dashboard.removeHint: Removes the editorial reference. The video and its files are preserved.
dashboard.actionError: The action could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
dashboard.independentTimes: Preparing, recording and publishing are independent stages.
